# Onboarding

Use this template to help a new contributor or future agent understand the project quickly.

---

## 15-Minute Path

| Step | Read | Goal |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `docs/README.md` | Understand the docs map |
| 2 | `docs/TASKS.md` | Find active work |
| 3 | `docs/planning/ROADMAP.md` | Understand priorities |
| 4 | `docs/reference/RUNBOOK.md` | Learn operations |
| 5 | `docs/architecture/DECISIONS.md` | Understand decisions |

---

## Before Changing Anything

- Check `TASKS.md`.
- Check the owning canonical tracker.
- Check `CHANGELOG.md` for recent changes.
- Check `DECISIONS.md` before reversing a decision.

---

## Definition of Ready

- Clear next action.
- Expected evidence is known.
- Dependencies are not blocked.
- Scope is small enough to verify.

---

## Definition of Done

- Change is complete.
- Verification evidence exists.
- Owning canonical tracker is updated.
- Cross-document references are not stale.

---
